question: Why is someone called a knower of the jewel after first using the means of certainty?
premises: At first one may not know the true nature of the jewel.
Practice through the means of certainty precedes direct attainment.
Attainment of the non-conceptual without means follows.
inference: One is called a knower of the jewel because mediated practice leads to direct non-conceptual attainment.
plain_english: One who at first does not know the true nature of the jewel, but practices through the means of certainty, is called a knower of the jewel when the non-conceptual is attained without means.
